target_name: Rancho Santa Maria de Los Penasquitos
note_on_land: All items below depict the San Diego County Rancho Santa Maria de Los Penasquitos (grantee Francisco Maria Ruiz, 1823; bought by Francisco Maria Alvarado 1837; expanded by Capt. George Alonzo Johnson 1862; sold to Jacob Shell Taylor 1880 -> 'Johnson-Taylor'). This land became present-day Rancho Penasquitos / Mira Mesa / Carmel Valley, San Diego. It is NOT the Orange County city of Rancho Santa Margarita, and NOT the San Diego 'Santa Margarita y Las Flores' (Camp Pendleton). Two flagged records (SDHC Miramar/Meanley; an SDHC adobe album that also contains Rancho Santa Margarita, San Diego) are adjacent/different land and are noted per item.

physical_only_collections: San Diego History Center - Research Archives / Booth Historical Photograph Archives, 1649 El Prado, Suite 3, Balboa Park, San Diego, CA 92101. Phone (619) 232-6203; research library archives@sandiegohistory.org. Holds the largest body of Rancho Los Penasquitos / Johnson-Taylor photographs (>112 catalog records incl. Strahlmann Collection, SD Historical Society Negative Collection, glass-plate & nitrate negatives ca.1887-1935). Images are order-on-request; not displayed online. Also holds the 'Rancho de los Penasquitos' photograph file (7 books) and manuscript collections MS 305, MS 49, MS 294.

California State Archives, 1020 O Street, Sacramento, CA 95814, (916) 653-2246, ArchivesWeb@sos.ca.gov - United States Surveyor General Maps: 'Penasquitos, Los' plat, ref MC 4:4-406 (F. M. Ruiz, 8,486.01 ac, patent 1876). Reproduction on request.

The Bancroft Library, UC Berkeley - 'Maps of private land grant cases of California' (diseños/land-case maps). No Penasquitos diseno located in this session (see dead_ends); worth a direct on-site/finding-aid check for the Los Penasquitos land case file.

Friends of Los Penasquitos Canyon Preserve (penasquitos.org) and San Diego County Parks (Los Penasquitos Ranch House / Ranch House museum) - local historic-photo holdings and the on-site interpretive collection; contact via penasquitos.org.
IS Architecture (isarchitecture.com) - authored the Los Penasquitos Ranch Mohnike Adobe Barn Historic Structure Report (may contain historic photos of ranch outbuildings).
